label: SXT LTE kit-US
description: MikroTik SXT LTE kit-US (RBSXTR&R11e-LTE-US) — 2x 100M RJ45, LTE radio. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Port roles from MikroTik's own spec table: **PoE in 802.3af/at** (12-57 V) on `eth1` and **PoE-out ports: Ether2** (passive PoE up to 57 V). The table names only the PoE-out port; the prose says the *second* port carries PoE-out, which leaves the first port as the drop that powers the unit. `eth1` records the PD draw as the published **Max power consumption 22 W** (5 W without attachments). `eth2` is the PSE side: no wattage budget is published for it - the table gives current limits (600 mA low-voltage, 400 mA high-voltage) against whatever supply is plugged in - so `poe.budgetUnknown` is set rather than a number obtained by multiplying 600 mA by a voltage MikroTik never pairs it with.
